propositions: Operator-attested describes evidence location, not actor identity; agents may freely record truthful concrete evidence they observed
Adding the [operator-attested] criterion tag after plan certification edits description material, invalidating the signed attestation as stale-material before completion can reuse it
Evidence classification must occur before plan review; concrete evidence may then be recorded in non-material ticket comments without invalidating the review

A genuine design conflict exists between plan-review anti-tamper semantics (early classification, material pinning) and completion-remediation guidance that requires late description edits for untagged evidence
ADR 0043 and plan-writing guide now document the classify-before-review / comment-afterward ordering and preserve existing exact-tag, specificity, and command-versus-attestation safeguards
